thief.ai: moving right: each step if x > W-W/3 then 25% turn, forced turn if x > W-100; moving left: if x < W/3 25% turn, forced if x < 100; turn anim plays once
thief.hit: plays thief_05 (each frame 12 ticks), barf.wav once, then continues in previous direction
thief.shadow: current frame drawn scaled (w, h/5) alpha 100 at same anchor

players.handSprite: 03/hand{slot+1}.png frames 0..4 pull/release, last frame = score tag
players.handX: layout formula; moves ±6 px/tick, clamp [50, W-50]
players.scoreTag: x = OX + 67 + (487/n)/2 + k*(487/n), y = OY+18; '%d' hits in player colour

shot.fireAnim: hand frames advance 1/tick to frameCount-1 then stone spawns
shot.stone: 03/stone.png from (handX, handY); y -= 12 per tick; scale (3 - t/4)/3; shadow at y+100 alpha 0x40; pop.wav (vol 0x40)
shot.hitTest: at tick 13 test 5 points (x,y),(x±5,y),(x,y±5) against thief's current frame opaque pixels (FUN_00420fd0)

controls.keyboard/joystick: key0 down = pull (draw), key0 up = release → fire; key2 held = left, key3 held = right
controls.mouse: pull when cursorY > 2H/3, fire when pulled and cursorY < H/2 (flick up); mouse button 0 held = left, button 1 held = right (button order INFERRED)
controls.onlyOneStone: input ignored/flushed while own stone in flight

ai: each tick 5/6 chance: if no stone: d=|thiefX-handX|; d<5 and pulled → fire; not pulled and d<30 → pull; move 6 px toward thief only when thief is moving toward the same side (handX<thiefX and thief moving right → +6; handX>=thiefX and moving left → -6)
timer: 30 s (1200 ticks) then TIME IS UP → score result with score = hits*10
bg: 03/bg frame0 (sky/trees) and frame1 (ground, hy=66) at (W/2,H/2), repeated ±640; frame3 timer band
